ott.settings_group_interface.description: Title of the native Classic group for interface settings.

ott.settings_group_lists.description: Title of the native Classic group for list settings.

ott.settings_group_infobar.description: Title of the native Classic group for playback information-bar settings.

ott.settings_group_buttons.description: Title of the native Classic group for button settings.

ott.settings_save.description: Action that durably saves the current Classic settings group draft.

ott.settings_draft_help.value: Changes are saved only with Save Settings
ott.settings_draft_help.description: Group draft help. Save Settings names the settings_save action; closing the draft does not save it.

ott.settings_value_return.value: Return to the group without changing this value
ott.settings_value_return.description: Value-picker return action help. Returning leaves this value unchanged in the group draft.

ott.settings_changed.description: The settings snapshot changed; the user must reopen this group before editing.

ott.settings_saving.description: Status while the current settings group is being saved.

ott.settings_saved.description: Status after the settings group has been saved.

ott.settings_separate.description: Heading for settings actions that save separately from the current group draft.

ott.settings_separate_help.description: These actions save their own changes independently of Save Settings.

ott.settings_separate_close_help.value: Closing does not undo changes already saved
ott.settings_separate_close_help.description: Closing this section cannot undo changes its independent actions have already saved.

ott.settings_font_scale.description: Title of the setting for interface text scale, shown as a percentage.

ott.settings_parental_unlock.description: Action granting access through the existing parental-control check; does not disable the PIN.

ott.settings_parental_create.description: Action to set the parental-control PIN.

ott.settings_parental_disable.description: Action to disable the parental-control PIN through the existing authorization flow.

ott.settings_parental_channels.description: Action toggling parental protection of channel access.

ott.settings_parental_settings.description: Action toggling parental protection of settings.

ott.settings_parental_providers.description: Action toggling parental protection of provider selection.

ott.settings_group_remote.description: Title of the native Classic section containing separate remote-control settings actions.

ott.settings_group_parental.description: Title of the native Classic section containing separate parental-control settings actions.

ott.settings_font_scale_prompt.description: Prompt for entering the interface text scale. The accepted range is 20–200 percent.

ott.settings_font_scale_invalid.description: Validation error for interface text scale. Enter a whole number in the inclusive range 20–200.

ott.settings_show_number.description: Channel list setting: show the channel number in each list row.

ott.settings_show_name.description: Channel list setting: show the channel name in each list row.

ott.settings_show_program.description: Channel list setting: show the programme name in each list row.

ott.settings_show_description.description: Channel list setting: show descriptions in the list.

ott.settings_yes.description: Affirmative choice for a boolean setting, such as showing a channel-list field.

ott.settings_no.description: Negative choice for a boolean setting, such as hiding a channel-list field.
